ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is the volume of added HCl (mL), and the vertical axis is pH. The curve starts from about pH 11 and gradually decreases as HCl is added; near about 23–24 mL, a very steep decreasing region appears, namely the equivalence point region. Labeled arrows A, B, C, D are located in the buffer region before the equivalence point, E points to the steep-drop region, and F is located in the acidic region after the equivalence point. Reasoning: When a weak base is titrated by a strong acid, at the half-equivalence point, weak base B and its conjugate acid BH+ have equal concentrations, therefore pOH = pKb, so pH = 14 - pKb. The equivalence point volume is about 23–24 mL, and the half-equivalence point volume is about 11–12 mL. The arrow in the figure closest to this half-equivalence point position is C.

method.method_draft: First inspect the graph: the steep equivalence-region drop occurs near 23–24 mL, so the half-equivalence volume is near 11–12 mL. Use the titration rule that for a weak base with strong acid, pH = 14 - pKb at the half-equivalence point. Match the half-equivalence location on the curve to the labeled arrows; this corresponds to arrow C.

method.method_draft: First inspect the graph to estimate the initial pH and the equivalence volume. Use the equivalence volume with 0.075 M HCl and the given 25.0 mL base sample to estimate the initial base concentration. From the initial pH, compute initial [OH-], estimate Kb, then calculate 14 - pKb. Finally, compare that pH value with the vertical positions of the arrows on the plotted curve; the matching point is C.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是弱碱被强酸 HCl 滴定的 pH-体积曲线。纵轴是 pH，横轴是加入 HCl 的体积 mL。曲线起始 pH 约为 10.7 到 11，随后缓慢下降；在约 23 mL 附近出现陡直下降，说明等量点大约在 23 mL 左右。箭头 A、B、C、D 位于缓冲区的不同位置，E 在陡降区附近，F 在强酸过量后的低 pH 区。箭头 C 指向约 10 到 11 mL、pH 约 8.5 到 8.7 的位置。
推理：按图估计等量点体积约为 23 mL。0.075 M HCl 在等量点消耗的物质的量约为 0.075 mol/L × 0.023 L = 0.0017 mol，因此 25.0 mL 初始弱碱浓度约为 0.0017 mol / 0.0250 L = 0.069 M。初始 pH 约 10.7，因此 pOH 约为 14 - 10.7 = 3.3，[OH-] 约为 10^-3.3 ≈ 5 × 10^-4 M。对弱碱，Kb ≈ [OH-]^2 / Cb ≈ (5 × 10^-4)^2 / 0.069 ≈ 4 × 10^-6，所以 pKb 约为 5.4。于是 14 - pKb 约为 8.6。图上 pH 约 8.6 的位置对应箭头 C。
